title: Are exams necessary? – B1 English Listening Test

seo.title: Are exams necessary? – B1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: English listening comprehension test for intermediate students (CEFR B1). Listen to three people talk about exams and answer the questions.

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Listen to three people talk about the necessity of exams. Match each opinion with a person. There are two opinions for each person, and there is one extra opinion that none of the speakers talks about.

See the full list of B1 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Still takes exams as a way to measure progress in his/her new interests.
Doing well in exams doesn't give you useful workplace skills.
Exams can test many different skills if they are well-designed.
Doing exams has had an impact on his/her personality.
People would learn better if they could study what they liked.
Without exams, people would not be motivated to learn.
Passing an exam was necessary to get his/her current job.
